purpose: Canonical quantity names for cross-solver comparison. alias lists are matched case-insensitively against flattened artifact paths (last path segment first, then full path tail). component_identity declares how a total coefficient decomposes, which is what the adjudicator uses to attribute a cross-solver difference to term coverage instead of numerical error.

component_identity.coverage_reference: a solver is 'full-coverage' when it reports a total and at least two non-zero components whose sum closes onto that total

C_F_vs_C_ITTCT57.description: if two solvers cite the same frictional-correlation baseline but report friction coefficients differing from it by very different factors, the difference is a normalisation (denominator area / unit chain) difference and NOT numerical error

normalization_analyses.description: C_F / C_ITTCT57 per arm; a healthy friction arm sits near O(1) of the correlation it cites
C_F * S_wet removes the reference-area definition, leaving the dimensionless friction force; arms with different wetted-area conventions must agree in this form if they agree physically
